textwithimage_1820921095.text:
Versatile Micro ATX Motherboard for Embedded Computing Solutions

The MB991 Micro ATX motherboard, designed based on the Intel® Q170 chipset, supports a range of processors including the Intel® Xeon® E3 family, 7th and 6th Generation Intel® Core™, Intel® Pentium®, and Celeron® QC/DC processors. Featuring Intel® Gen 9 HD Graphics, it delivers enhanced video performance for stunning visuals and 4K playback. With a rich set of I/O and flexible expansion options, including PCIe slots, SATA III ports, and USB interfaces, this motherboard caters to various applications such as medical equipment, industrial control, and gaming machines. Equipped with dual Gigabit Ethernet, RAID support, TPM (2.0), iAMT (11.6), and iSMART technology, it ensures reliability, security, and environmental efficiency.

About IBASE

  • IBASE offers a range of embedded computing solutions tailored for various applications.
  • Their products feature advanced technologies such as iSMART for improved environmental performance.
  • IBASE motherboards support a wide range of processors, including Intel® Xeon®, Core™, Pentium®, and Celeron® series.
  • Security features like TPM and iAMT are integrated into IBASE motherboards to ensure data protection and manageability.
  • IBASE products are designed with reliability, versatility, and performance in mind, making them suitable for diverse industrial applications.
